$comment: Script schema v2.0-rc (S0 freeze, 2026-10-16). Generated from engine/validator/schema_v2.js. Catalog enums (moves, themes, objects, world commands) are filled in on export, as in v1.
title: StickmanStoryV3

bundles.description: Catalog bundles this script uses: each { id, version, hash } exactly as the bundle's context pack gives it. Names with a colon come from these bundles.

kind.description: story (default; at least 300 s), fight (fight-only video; at least 180 s) or clip (no minimum).

speech.description: Default speech for renders (SPEECH_SPEC 2): babble syllables or offline spoken voices.

off.description: Keep babble for this voice even in tts renders.

narrator.description: Spoken voice for narration in tts renders (SPEECH_SPEC 3).

lipSync.description: Mouths take shapes in time with spoken lines (STORY_SPEC 7.1a; default true). false keeps the plain open/closed flap.

name.description: Display name for HP bars and speaker labels.

body.description: Body plan from the catalog (default stickman; E_BODY_UNKNOWN).

prop.description: A holdable object kind (the v1 props are holdables).

belly.description: A belly patch color on a capsule body (buddy); hidden under an outfit.

slots.description: Lit gem slots on the bracelet (rainbow order).

accessories.description: Accessory name → color. Also accepts the v1 style accessories (headband, scarf, cape, hat).

off.description: Keep babble for this voice even in tts renders.

tts.description: Spoken voice for --speech tts renders (SPEECH_SPEC 3); the engine ignores it.

view.description: Turnaround view: side, three_quarter, front or back (the body plan must have it: E_VIEW_BODY).

limbStyle.description: How arms and legs are drawn: straight (default), bendy (smooth curves through elbows and knees) or rubber (cartoon noodle limbs that also stretch on fast reaches and hits).

state.description: Initial state for objects with states (door: open/closed).

z.description: Depth in px: 0 the stage line, positive toward the camera, negative away (checked against the scene's depth range: E_DEPTH_RANGE).

from.description: Left edge of their area (world px).

to.description: Right edge of their area (world px).

light.description: The light rig: a preset name from the catalog (noon, dawn, golden, moonlit, indoor, stage, gloom, flat; E_LIGHT_UNKNOWN), or { "preset", ...overrides }. Default: the preset for the scene's time of day.

location.description: A location id from 'locations', or a theme name (a location with defaults).

keepCast.description: Characters stay in full colour while the world is grey.

duration.description: Fixed length; otherwise the last beat's end plus tail.

target.description: iris: the character the circle closes on or opens from.
iris: the character the circle closes on or opens from.

face.description: Face from the catalog (checked semantically: E_FACE_UNKNOWN).

hidden.description: Placed but invisible until it enters (spawn move or the enter macro).

z.description: Depth in px: 0 the stage line, positive toward the camera, negative away (checked against the scene's depth range: E_DEPTH_RANGE).

view.description: Turnaround view: side, three_quarter, front or back (the body plan must have it: E_VIEW_BODY).

limbStyle.description: This character's limb style in this scene (over the scene's and the cast entry's).

state.description: Initial state for objects with states (door: open/closed).

z.description: Depth in px: 0 the stage line, positive toward the camera, negative away (checked against the scene's depth range: E_DEPTH_RANGE).

set.description: Extra set pieces for this scene only.

from.description: Left edge of their area (world px).

to.description: Right edge of their area (world px).

at.description: When the beat runs: seconds from the scene start, or relative to another beat in the same scene.

on.description: <beatId>.<anchor>: start, windowOpen, hit, end, or a macro anchor.

from.description: over_shoulder: the character the camera looks past.

dolly.description: Move the camera toward (+) or away from (-) the stage, px: near things grow faster than far ones.

truck.description: Slide the camera sideways, px; depth layers slide past each other.

crane.description: Raise (-) or lower (+) the camera, px.

tilt.description: Tilt the view up (+) or down (-), degrees.

roll.description: Lean the frame, degrees (a dutch angle).

push.description: A zoom multiplier on top of the framing (1 = none).

dof.description: Depth of field: how much things away from the focus blur.

lag.description: Follow with lag: 0 tight, 1 trailing well behind.

move.description: A named camera move from the catalog (push_in, pull_out, slow_push, crane_up, crane_down, orbit_sweep, dutch_tilt, level, handheld; E_CAMERA_MOVE).

at.description: When the beat runs: seconds from the scene start, or relative to another beat in the same scene.

on.description: <beatId>.<anchor>: start, windowOpen, hit, end, or a macro anchor.

who.description: A character id, or "world" for effects, camera, objects, narration and cards.

do.description: A move name (characters) or a world command.

params.description: Move or world-command params: numbers, strings, booleans, or a short list of ids (activity `with`).

face.description: Emotion from this beat on: a face from the catalog (E_FACE_UNKNOWN).

partner.description: The other character in a paired move.

object.description: The object (set piece or spawned object id) the beat acts on.

z.description: Depth in px: 0 the stage line, positive toward the camera, negative away (checked against the scene's depth range: E_DEPTH_RANGE).

view.description: The character turns to this view from this beat on (E_VIEW_BODY).

at.description: When the beat runs: seconds from the scene start, or relative to another beat in the same scene.

on.description: <beatId>.<anchor>: start, windowOpen, hit, end, or a macro anchor.

macro.description: A story macro; the compiler expands it into beats.

depth.description: The scene's depth lane (defaults: near 600, far -2000, focal 2400, horizon 260).

near.description: Nearest z a node may have (toward the camera).

far.description: Farthest z a node may have.

focal.description: Camera focal length: scale = focal / (focal - z).

horizon.description: How far (px) the feet line rises for a node at infinite distance.

light.description: The light rig: a preset name from the catalog (noon, dawn, golden, moonlit, indoor, stage, gloom, flat; E_LIGHT_UNKNOWN), or { "preset", ...overrides }. Default: the preset for the scene's time of day.

lens.description: The lens the scene starts with (V3.4); camera keys and set_camera change it. Defaults: vignette 0.18, no depth of field, autoFocus on.

dolly.description: Move the camera toward (+) or away from (-) the stage, px: near things grow faster than far ones.

truck.description: Slide the camera sideways, px; depth layers slide past each other.

crane.description: Raise (-) or lower (+) the camera, px.

tilt.description: Tilt the view up (+) or down (-), degrees.

roll.description: Lean the frame, degrees (a dutch angle).

push.description: A zoom multiplier on top of the framing (1 = none).

dof.description: Depth of field: how much things away from the focus blur.

autoFocus.description: Close-ups, over-the-shoulder shots and two-shots pull focus by themselves (default true).

limbStyle.description: Limb style for everyone in the scene (over each cast entry's; a placement's own limbStyle wins).

post.description: Post effects over the whole frame (V3.5); a scene's post overrides the script's.

oneOf.description: Snappy preschool-show timing (ADR-038): faster travel and gestures, tight dialogue, a cutting auto camera with medium shots, cut-to-arrival for long walks, bigger bubbles or subtitles. {} takes every default.

travel.description: Speed multipliers per travel move (defaults: walk 1.7, run 1.25, sneak 2.5, tiptoe 2, walk_together 1.6, swim 1.3).

moves.description: Playback speed of other one-shot moves beats start (not attacks, defeats, paired moves, timed holds or speaking beats; default 1.25).

maxTravel.description: Seconds a walk may take on screen before it becomes a walk out, a cut and the arrival (default 3).

maxExit.description: Seconds an exit walk lasts before the fade (default 1.5).

arrive.description: Seconds of walking after a travel cut (default 1.2).

leave.description: Seconds of walking before a travel cut (default 0.9).

shot.description: [min, max] seconds a dialogue shot lasts before the auto camera cuts (default [2, 4]).

establish.description: Seconds of the opening wide shot (default 2); a narrated scene can stay wide throughout.

minCut.description: Fewest seconds between two auto camera cuts (default shot[0] / 2).

glide.description: Seconds the paced camera eases from one framing to the next instead of cutting (default 0: hard cuts; scene changes, cut-to-arrival and script cuts stay cuts).

framing.description: cutting (default): shot/reverse-shot per line, reaction and face close-ups. calm: one steady medium per exchange that widens only for a new speaker, no reaction or face close-ups, and every framing holds still until its subjects drift away. single: every line frames its speaker alone (for portrait Shorts).

keepSpeakers.description: A script shot that leaves out a character who starts speaking gives way to a shot of them (default true).

reactions.description: Cut to the listener's face when a line runs past shot[1] (default true).

captions.description: auto (default): subtitles when meta.speech is tts, else bubbles.

bubble.description: Bubble and text scale, times look.bubble (default 1.5).

pace.description: This scene's pace over the script's, or false for none.

macro.description: A scene macro; expands into several scenes.

target.description: iris: the character the circle closes on or opens from.
iris: the character the circle closes on or opens from.

voices.description: Speech sounds while characters talk (default true).

tracks.description: Audio tracks over the story's own sound (V3.8): music, ambience, sound effects and bus gains.

scene.description: Times are from this scene's start and the track plays inside it.

mood.description: music: a mood from the catalog (E_AUDIO_TRACK).

at.description: sfx: when it plays: seconds, or { "marker", "delay" }.

bus.description: bus: the part of the mix the volume keys scale.

volume.description: Volume (1 = as mixed): a number, or keys [{ "t", "v", "ease" }] in seconds from the track's base (its scene's start, or the video start).

pan.description: Pan (-1 left, 1 right): a number, or keys [{ "t", "v", "ease" }] in seconds from the track's base (its scene's start, or the video start).

intensity.description: music: how busy the generated music is.

markers.description: Named moments: { "id", "scene", "t" } (seconds into the scene). Beats can start at one: "at": { "marker": "drop" } (E_MARKER_UNKNOWN).

duck.description: Ducking rules: lower one stem while something else sounds.

under.description: voice (speech and narration), sfx (sound effects), or a track id.

layers.description: Named layers that group text and shapes (V3.5).

scene.description: Times are from this scene's start, and the element shows only in that scene.

z.description: Draw order inside its layer (or among layers).

place.description: back: after the background, before the world; over (default): over the world.

space.description: screen (default): 1920 x 1080 frame units; world: stage px, moving with the camera.

reveal.description: How much of the layer shows, wiping from the left (keyable).

text.description: Titles, captions, lower thirds and labels (V3.5).

style.description: A text style from the catalog (title, subtitle, caption, lower_third, comic, label; E_TEXT_STYLE).

scene.description: Times are from this scene's start, and the element shows only in that scene.

z.description: Draw order inside its layer (or among layers).

reveal.description: How many of the letters show (keyable; the typewriter animation sets it).

shapes.description: Rectangles, circles, ellipses, lines and paths with fills, gradients and strokes (V3.5).

scene.description: Times are from this scene's start, and the element shows only in that scene.

z.description: Draw order inside its layer (or among layers).

r.description: Circle radius, or a rectangle's corner radius.

d.description: Path commands as in imported art: ["M", x, y], ["L", x, y], ["C", ...], ["Q", ...], ["Z"].

angle.description: Linear gradients: 90 runs top to bottom.

target.description: layer.<id>.<prop>, text.<id>.<prop>, shape.<id>.<prop>, lens.<channel> or post.<prop> (E_TRACK_TARGET).

v.description: A number, or a #rrggbb colour for color, fill and stroke.

ease.description: An easing name, "step", "cubic-bezier(x1, y1, x2, y2)" or [x1, y1, x2, y2] (E_TRACK_EASE).

post.description: Post effects over the whole frame (V3.5); a scene's post overrides the script's.

motion.description: Motion quality for v3 scenes, drawn over the stored motion (the simulation is unchanged).

followThrough.description: Arms and head trail and overshoot their poses (default 1).

squash.description: Stretch in the air, squash on landing and along a hit (default 1).

breathing.description: The upper body breathes while standing still (default 1).

stretch.description: Rubber limbs stretch on fast reaches and when a blow lands (default 1).

spine.description: The back bends: a hunch or an arch with the lean, a swing that trails the torso, a fold on landings and blows (default 1 for bendy and rubber limbs, 0 for straight ones; rubber bends 1.35x).

strength.description: How strong the automatic lighting, vignette, focus blur and turns are (default 0.2; explicit lights, lens settings and views are always full).

outline.description: Scale of the dark outline around limbs, heads and bodies (default 1).

bubble.description: Scale of speech bubbles and their text (default 1).

maxTurn.description: How far a body turns from profile toward or away from the camera, in degrees (default 90: full front and back; 60: front is a near-front three-quarter).

pace.description: Snappy preschool-show timing (ADR-038): faster travel and gestures, tight dialogue, a cutting auto camera with medium shots, cut-to-arrival for long walks, bigger bubbles or subtitles. {} takes every default.

travel.description: Speed multipliers per travel move (defaults: walk 1.7, run 1.25, sneak 2.5, tiptoe 2, walk_together 1.6, swim 1.3).

moves.description: Playback speed of other one-shot moves beats start (not attacks, defeats, paired moves, timed holds or speaking beats; default 1.25).

maxTravel.description: Seconds a walk may take on screen before it becomes a walk out, a cut and the arrival (default 3).

maxExit.description: Seconds an exit walk lasts before the fade (default 1.5).

arrive.description: Seconds of walking after a travel cut (default 1.2).

leave.description: Seconds of walking before a travel cut (default 0.9).

shot.description: [min, max] seconds a dialogue shot lasts before the auto camera cuts (default [2, 4]).

establish.description: Seconds of the opening wide shot (default 2); a narrated scene can stay wide throughout.

minCut.description: Fewest seconds between two auto camera cuts (default shot[0] / 2).

glide.description: Seconds the paced camera eases from one framing to the next instead of cutting (default 0: hard cuts; scene changes, cut-to-arrival and script cuts stay cuts).

framing.description: cutting (default): shot/reverse-shot per line, reaction and face close-ups. calm: one steady medium per exchange that widens only for a new speaker, no reaction or face close-ups, and every framing holds still until its subjects drift away. single: every line frames its speaker alone (for portrait Shorts).

keepSpeakers.description: A script shot that leaves out a character who starts speaking gives way to a shot of them (default true).

reactions.description: Cut to the listener's face when a line runs past shot[1] (default true).

captions.description: auto (default): subtitles when meta.speech is tts, else bubbles.

bubble.description: Bubble and text scale, times look.bubble (default 1.5).

lines.description: [speaker, text], [speaker, text, face] or [speaker, text, face, bubble]; text up to 120 characters, split into 40-character bubbles.

object.description: Use this set piece (a bench, a net) instead of spawning one.

finisher.description: Attack move for the last exchange.

ko.description: Loser ends knocked out (default true); false leaves them standing for a defeat macro.

description: A v2 story with the optional depth fields of ENGINE_V3_SPEC 7 (z on placements, set pieces and walks; a scene depth block).
